title: Hom-functor
description: JSON Schema for a hom-functor — Hom_C(-, A) (contravariant) or Hom_C(A, -) (covariant) (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §2; Awodey 2010 §8.1). Specializes functor by adding the fixed object and a direction discriminator. Uses oneOf with direction ∈ {covariant, contravariant} to dispatch the two variants — exercising the JSON Schema 2020-12 oneOf-as-tagged-union feature on a categorical primitive.

at-object.description: The fixed object A — the Hom argument that is held constant.

direction.description: Whether the hom-functor is the covariant Hom(A, -) or the contravariant Hom(-, A).
